features.name: Achievements
features.note: Steam achievements are not unlocked in the coop campaign.

features.name: Arena
features.note: The arena is not available yet.

features.name: Catch-up speed for a lagging player
Bandit lairs
features.note: Bandit hideouts never appear on the map, so they can't be found or attacked.

features.name: Bandits, deserters and manhunters on the map
features.note: Deserter bands don't grow with your level, and bandits don't go after richer players more than poorer ones.

features.name: Banners
features.note: Your multiplayer banner does not show on your party yet.

features.name: Sending your troops in without you
features.note: You cannot order your troops to fight a battle without you.

features.name: Returning to the campaign after a battle
Battle chooser when no battle is open
features.note: Pressing B when no battle is running does nothing instead of saying so.

features.name: Only an admin can end a battle
features.note: Any player in a battle can end it early through a hidden request; only the host should be able to.

features.name: Changing equipment before spawning in a battle
In-battle menus (Esc menu, game rules, troop choice, admin panel)
Battle servers and the battle chooser
Relation gains from battles
features.note: Helping a lord win a battle does not improve your relation with him yet.

features.name: Retreat when the battle's leader disconnects
features.note: If the player who started a battle disconnects, the others cannot retreat and must fight it out.

features.name: Reading books
features.note: You can buy books but cannot read them yet.

features.name: Camping, waiting and resting
features.note: You can't set up camp or wait in the field. You can wait inside a town, but resting there has no cost or effects yet. Time runs at one speed for everyone.

features.name: Pausing the campaign (host)
features.note: The host's pause command does not actually pause the campaign.

features.name: Defeat, captivity and escape
features.note: Losing a battle never makes you a prisoner; you escape at once.

features.name: Castle visits
features.note: Town and castle gates have no guards or meeting requests yet.

features.name: Cattle herds
features.note: Cattle herds you own cannot be driven, stopped or slaughtered yet.

features.name: Buying cattle from the elder
features.note: Buying cattle from a village elder does not work yet.

features.name: Center reports (cheat)
features.note: Cheat-only report pages are not part of coop.

features.name: Internal cleanup: unused start-location message
features.note: Internal cleanup: an unused network message is still defined.

features.name: Battle names pushed to players (faction, troop classes, heroes)
Character creation
features.note: Character creation applies your background's stats, but not its starting gold, renown or honor, and you cannot pick a starting town yet.

features.name: Cheats and debug menus
features.note: Native cheats are not available in coop; hosts have a separate debug mode.

features.name: Claimants
features.note: Claimants to the thrones cannot be found or supported yet.

features.name: Public build on a clean machine
Companion equipment and skill points
features.note: Items you hand to a companion can be lost; don't give companions equipment yet.

features.name: Companion missions
features.note: Companions cannot be sent on missions yet.

features.name: Companion complaints and departures
features.note: Companions never complain, quarrel or leave the party.

features.name: Talking to companions in your party
In-game server address menu
features.note: Join through the server browser or a Steam invite.

features.name: Courtship and marriage
features.note: You can talk to ladies, but courting and marriage progress is not saved yet.

features.name: Custom and quick battles
features.note: Custom battles are a single-player mode and are not part of the coop campaign.

features.name: Internal code cleanup
features.note: Internal cleanup, no effect on play.

features.name: Developer analysis tools kept current
features.note: Internal tooling fix, no player-visible effect.

features.name: Developer build and test tools
features.note: Internal developer tooling, no effect on play.

features.name: Wars, peace and lord politics
features.note: Wars and peace run for the whole world, but lords held in castle prisons never escape yet.

features.name: Retreating, surrendering and sending troops in without you
features.note: When an enemy attacks you on the map you can simply leave; there is no retreat with a rearguard, no surrender, and no sending your troops in without you.

features.name: Enemy towns and castles turn players away
features.note: Enemy towns and castles do not turn players away yet.

features.name: Capturing or releasing a beaten lord
features.note: Beaten lords are captured or escape automatically; you cannot choose to let them go.

features.name: Enterprises
features.note: Enterprises are not available yet.

features.name: Serving a kingdom (per-player faction)
features.note: Players cannot join a kingdom yet; everyone plays as an independent.

features.name: Faction relations report
features.note: The faction relations report shows outdated relations.

features.name: Feasts
features.note: Feasts are not available yet: you are never invited and cannot host one.

features.name: Fiefs and their management
features.note: Captured castles and towns go to the players as a group; nobody can own or manage a fief yet.

features.name: Food and supplies
features.note: Your party does not eat food yet, and food never spoils.

features.name: Greetings from townsfolk, guards and soldiers
Honor
features.note: Honor is not kept yet: gains and losses are forgotten and lords do not take it into account.

features.name: Internal engine-hook cleanup
features.note: Internal code cleanup, no player-visible effect.

features.name: Hosting and the server password
features.note: On a passworded server, players must also put the password in their own coop.ini or they cannot join battles.

features.name: Joining a battle already under way
features.note: You cannot join a battle that two other armies are already fighting.

features.name: Tournaments with several players
features.note: Players cannot yet compete in the same tournament.

features.name: The world moves on: lords, caravans, prosperity
Joining a server battle right after a local fight
Garrison losses counted as yours after a local siege
features.note: After a siege you lead yourself, you can lose troops of the same type as the defenders.

features.name: Lords defending a castle in a local siege
features.note: In a siege you lead yourself, lords stationed in the castle do not take part in the defense.

features.name: Battle loot
features.note: Winning a battle gives no item loot yet.

features.name: Lords reacting to each player
features.note: Lords do not yet act on how much they like you: they will not ride to your aid or invite you to feasts.

features.name: Talking to lords
features.note: You can talk to lords in their halls, but not when you meet them on the map, and some conversation outcomes such as selling a prisoner do not stick yet.

features.name: Lord relations report
features.note: The lord relations list can be slightly off: your honor is not taken into account correctly and lords who changed status may be missing.

features.name: Lord's hall
features.note: Every lady staying in a town or castle shows up in its hall, even those who would not receive you.

features.name: Talking to parties on the map
features.note: You can't talk to parties you meet on the map: no bargaining with bandits, no demanding surrender, no chatting with lords, caravans or farmers.

features.name: Map encounters
features.note: Every party you meet on the map is treated as hostile for now.

features.name: Party icon on the map (rider, camp)
features.note: Your party always shows the walking icon on the map, even when you ride.

features.name: Choosing where to start on the map
features.note: New characters cannot choose where they start on the map.

features.name: Marshals and kingdom campaigns
features.note: Kingdom campaigns run without you: marshals never call on players yet.

features.name: Mercenary contracts
features.note: Lords offer mercenary contracts, but accepting one has no lasting effect yet.

features.name: Map parties a player missed on join reappear
Low-morale desertion
features.note: Troops never desert when your party's morale is low.

features.name: Native multiplayer modes
features.note: Native Warband's multiplayer modes are not part of the coop campaign.

features.name: Notes and encyclopedia
features.note: The Notes screen shows outdated or empty information about lords, towns and kingdoms.

features.name: Party morale
features.note: Party morale does not change yet.

features.name: Party and troop upgrades
features.note: Recruiting and upgrading work, but party size is not limited by leadership yet.

features.name: The player's kingdom
features.note: Founding and ruling your own kingdom is not available yet.

features.name: Town prison
features.note: Town and castle prisons cannot be visited yet.

features.name: Ransom offers for captured lords
features.note: Factions never offer ransom for lords you hold.

features.name: Recruiting prisoners
features.note: You cannot recruit your prisoners yet.

features.name: Selling prisoners to ransom brokers
features.note: Prisoners cannot be sold to ransom brokers yet.

features.name: Battles between players of enemy kingdoms
features.note: Players on opposite sides of a war cannot fight each other yet.

features.name: Guild master: deal with night bandits
Guild master: deliver wine
features.note: Wine delivery works, but the quest title shows the wrong amount and names.

features.name: Save a village from bandits (tavern farmer's plea)
features.note: A farmer in the tavern can give you a quest to save his village, but it can't be completed yet.

features.name: Guild master: escort a merchant caravan
features.note: Escorting a caravan works, but you can't talk to the caravan on the map to make it wait or follow.

features.name: Failed guild master quests: debts and penalties
features.note: Failing a guild master's quest has no penalty yet: no debt to the guild.

features.name: Guild master: ransom a kidnapped girl
Guild master: move a cattle herd
Guild master: persuade two lords to make peace
features.note: Persuading lords to make peace is in, but untested, and turning down the reward gives no honour.

features.name: Guild master: hunt down troublesome bandits
features.note: Hunting troublesome bandits counts as done even if someone else kills them.

features.name: Village elder quests: deliver cattle, train peasants
features.note: Village elders only ask for grain; the cattle and peasant-training quests aren't in yet.

features.name: Guild master bounties: track down bandits, retaliate for a border incident
features.note: Guild masters don't offer bandit bounties or border-retaliation jobs yet.

features.name: The merchant's brother (opening quest)
features.note: The opening quest with the merchant's brother isn't in coop; new characters start directly on the map.

features.name: Army and kingdom quests
features.note: Army and kingdom quests aren't in yet; they need joining a kingdom first.

features.name: Lord quests
features.note: Lords don't give quests yet.

features.name: Recruiting volunteers
features.note: Recruiting volunteers works from the village menu, but prices and who may recruit differ from single player, and asking the elder does nothing yet.

features.name: Relations and renown
features.note: Relations and renown are kept per player, but renown never slowly fades the way it does in single player.

features.name: Reports
features.note: The Reports menu shows placeholder values instead of your own renown, honor, party size, morale and companions.

features.name: Retirement and game end
features.note: Retirement is not part of coop; your character stays saved on the server.

features.name: Saving and loading
features.note: The shared world is only saved when the host saves it from the server console; characters save on their own.

features.name: Sea travel
features.note: Sea travel is a cheat-only option in native Warband and is not part of coop.

features.name: Timed server jobs run on schedule (autosave, quest tick)
Visiting a town together
features.note: Only one player can visit a town at a time for now; visiting together is planned for the end of the roadmap.

features.name: Besieging: siege camp, ladders, towers and parley
features.note: Sieges start straight away: there is no siege camp, no ladders or towers to build and no talks with the defenders.

features.name: Claiming a conquered castle or town
features.note: Captured castles and towns go to a shared player faction; you cannot claim them for yourself yet.

features.name: Defending a besieged castle or town
features.note: You cannot help defend a castle or town under siege.

features.name: Sneaking into enemy towns
features.note: Sneaking into enemy towns is not available yet.

features.name: Zendar, the inn, the salt mine and Dhorak Keep
features.note: Places that native Warband never shows on the map are not part of coop.

features.name: Spotting parties and tracks
features.note: Parties are spotted normally, but tracks on the map do not show yet.

features.name: Starting companion shared between players
features.note: Two players can end up with the same starting companion.

features.name: Starting gold, troops and gear
features.note: New characters start with a large test army and extra gold, and their background's starting equipment is replaced by a default kit.

features.name: A Steam player's character forked under the username
features.note: Rarely, a Steam player can join with a fresh character instead of their own when Steam is slow to report in.

features.name: Checking a player's Steam identity
features.note: Steam ids are not verified by the host; protect your server with a password.

features.name: Steam invites and the Steam tunnel
Warning when Steam is not running
Host tunnel crash when joiners connect early
features.note: If friends connect before the host is fully up, the host's Steam connection can drop and restart; start the host first.

features.name: Recovering the Steam tunnel
features.note: When the host is offline or Steam restarts, the connection gives up or recovers without telling the player what happened.

features.name: Tavern brawls and duels
features.note: Tavern brawls and assassins do not fight yet.

features.name: Buying the tavern a round
features.note: Buying a round for the tavern does not charge you properly yet.

features.name: Ransom broker
features.note: Ransoming a captured companion is built and waiting for a test; selling prisoners to the broker comes with prisoner selling.

features.name: Paying travellers for news
features.note: Travellers in taverns cannot be paid for news yet.

features.name: Tournaments
features.note: Tournaments cannot be entered yet.

features.name: Giving money to the poor in town
features.note: Giving money to the poor in town does not work correctly yet.

features.name: Assessing local prices
features.note: You cannot yet assess a town's prices from the marketplace.

features.name: Server-checked trade prices
features.note: The server does not yet check what you paid when trading with a merchant.

features.name: Training grounds
features.note: Training grounds are not available yet.

features.name: Tutorial
features.note: The tutorial is single-player only; learn the basics there before joining a coop campaign.

features.name: Unused native content
features.note: Leftover content that native Warband never uses is not part of coop.

features.name: Politics as a vassal (favours, prisoners for the liege, truces)
Swearing fealty
features.note: You can swear an oath to a king, but it is forgotten when you leave the hall.

features.name: Bandits infesting villages
features.note: Villages overrun by bandits cannot be freed yet.

features.name: Raiding villages
features.note: You cannot raid villages yet.

features.name: Buying from villages
features.note: Village trade works, but the server does not yet check the prices the game reports, and a looted or bandit-held village still sells.

features.name: Village menu and elder
features.note: Villages can be visited and the elder talked to, but a looted or bandit-held village is not closed off yet.

features.name: Weekly wages
features.note: Troops do not cost weekly wages yet.

features.name: News of wars, peace, sieges and raids
features.note: You are not told about world events such as wars, sieges and raids.

features.name: Healing over time
features.note: Wounds heal over time, but resting does not speed it up yet and lame horses stay lame.

milestones.name: Adventurer
milestones.summary: Travel, fight bandits, loot, trade, recruit, pay wages, be captured and escape, use taverns, the arena and tournaments, hire companions, do village work and early quests.

milestones.name: Mercenary & vassal
milestones.summary: Take contracts, follow marshal campaigns, swear fealty, receive a fief, do kingdom quests.

milestones.name: Lord
milestones.summary: Run fiefs and enterprises, court and marry, attend feasts, deal with lord politics.

milestones.name: Sovereign
milestones.summary: Found a kingdom, back a claimant, recruit lords, run the realm.

milestones.name: Full parity
milestones.summary: Everything left, including meta and reports.
